name: Dalton's cottage

status.note: Its later history is not researched here.

built.note: Standing in October 1871 (Andreas, volume two). Nobody recorded when it was built; 1864 stands in for the years before the fire.

summary: A one-storey frame cottage next door to the O'Learys, raised on cedar posts four feet off the ground. It stood only a few steps from the barn and burned in the first minutes.

notable.text: Its three side windows looked straight into the O'Learys' yard.

story.text: The fire breaks out in the O'Leary barn next door.
